title: W10 to W07 Membership Renewal Workflow Transport

producer.primaryResponsibility: Durable scheduling and bounded retry orchestration only

consumer.businessAuthority: Membership, subscription, order, payment, MIT mandate and renewal-cycle state

transport.kind: Cloudflare Workflow scheduled binding plus Worker Service Binding

durability.renewalOperationIdentity: W07 D1-04 subscription_renewal_cycles.cycle_id, stable for one subscription and billing period
duplicateExecutionProtection: stable order and payment idempotency keys
signed provider webhook and W07 outcome reconciliation

authority.W10: Owns only workflow scheduling, persisted step execution, retry and orchestration. It does not read/write D1-01 or D1-04 and cannot make payment, mandate, price, entitlement or subscription-state decisions.
authority.W07: Owns D1-04 renewal cycles, orders, payment attempts and MIT submission. It resolves Demo pricing/tax from the owning domain and performs scoped D1-01 subscription transitions after verified provider outcomes.
authority.providerOutcome: A synchronous HTTP response never grants entitlement. Signed HyperSwitch webhook/reconciliation remains the source for successful or failed payment outcomes.

failureSemantics.http5xxOrTransportFailure: Workflow step retries according to the bounded retry policy; W07 stable cycle/payment idempotency protects replays.
failureSemantics.partialOrSchemaNotReady: Workflow instance completes with the structured W07 result; the next scheduled invocation attempts recovery again.
failureSemantics.unknownPaymentOutcome: W07 leaves the cycle in reconciliation state and does not create a second payment attempt until authoritative outcome reconciliation permits it.
failureSemantics.poisonOrInvalidRequest: W07 rejects the internal call; Workflow records the failed instance. No payment side effect is inferred.

nonGoals: No new Worker, D1 database or Queue
No direct W07 Cron or scheduled handler
No W10 D1-01 or D1-04 business writes
No new subscription authority such as Kill Bill
No live charge, remote migration or production activation in this PR
